title: MyGO!!!!!/Band Story
subtitle: It's MyGO!!!!!
intro: Anon transfers into Haneoka at the end of spring, where she meets the mysterious girl, Tomori. A brand new story, of being lost and hurt, begins to unfold...

chapters.label: Chapter 01
chapters.title: Returns - Cold Rain
chapters.summary: A rainy studio, five girls, and memories from 1 year ago. Along with their lost hearts, a new story begins to unfold...

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: Saki-chan! I'm glad - you're here!

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: We've been worried about you for a long time, okay? You've been absent from school and you haven't responded at all, so--

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: I came here today because I have something to say.

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: I'm going to quit... CRYCHIC.

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: W-wait a minute... Why? What's wrong...?

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: ... You can't tell us? Or is it because of us? If something's wrong, we'll fix it...

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: No... because it's my problem alone.

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: ... Why? You had a great time at the live show the other night. You said you wanted to do it again, right?

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: ... I didn't say that.

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: Oh, really..? But you started CRYCHIC, didn't you? If you quit...

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: ... You're really going to quit?

lines.speaker: Taki
lines.text: ... Tomori asked you a question. Why aren't you answering?

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: Taki-chan, don't--

lines.speaker: Taki
lines.text: I mean, isn't that irresponsible? You've stood up so many times for practice, and then you'll quit without any explanation...

lines.speaker: Taki
lines.text: If you're going to quit, can you quit without causing us trouble? Even today, we were waiting for you--

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: Taki-chan!

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: ... You could have practiced without me, couldn't you?

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: There's no rule that says you can't do it unless everyone's here. Don't pin the blame on me.

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: But without Saki-chan--

lines.speaker: Sakiko
lines.text: Don't be so naive, you're the one who especially needs to practice, Tomori, what have you been doing all this time?

lines.speaker: Taki
lines.text: Tomori has been waiting for you!

lines.speaker: Soyo
lines.text: Wait...! Let's talk it out, okay? We've been having so much fun... You think so too, don't you, Mutsumi-chan?

lines.speaker: Mutsumi
lines.text: I've... never once had fun with the band.

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: Hmmm...! The interview's over!

dialogueGroups.title: Haneoka Girls' Academy Courtyard inner voice

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (I was president of the student council in junior high school, and my unofficial report isn't too bad either.)

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (It's a strange time to transfer, but I'm sure I'll be able to get in without any problems.)

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (Private Haneoka Girls' Academy, Senior High School...)

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: ... I'm going to start afresh here.

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: ... Hmm?

dialogueGroups.title: Haneoka Girls' Academy Courtyard inner voice

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (What's wrong with that girl...? Crouching down over there...)

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: ... Hey, did you drop something? Why don't we look for it together?

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: ... Hey? Didn't you hear me?

dialogueGroups.title: Haneoka Girls' Academy Courtyard inner voice

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (What is she looking for...? Picking up a rock?)

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: A stone in the shape of a dog... This one might be... a cat.

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: Oh, this one... has a pattern. It's a marble stone.

dialogueGroups.title: Haneoka Girls' Academy Courtyard inner voice

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: (She's putting the stones in her pocket...)

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: Uhm... are you going to take those stones home with you?

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: ...! Um, well, you know, that...

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: You finally noticed me. I've been talking to you for a long time...

lines.speaker: Tomori
lines.text: Um, good-bye...!

lines.speaker: Anon
lines.text: ... What? Huh...
